# openrouter_chat_completion (Resource)





<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `messages` (Block List, Min: 1) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--messages))
- `model` (String) The model to use for the completion. Example: openai/gpt-4.

### Optional

- `max_tokens` (Number) Maximum number of tokens to generate.
- `temperature` (Number) Sampling temperature (0-2). Higher values make output more random.
- `top_p` (Number) Nucleus sampling parameter. Higher values make output more focused.

### Read-Only

- `completion_tokens` (Number) Number of tokens in the completion.
- `content` (String) The generated completion content.
- `finish_reason` (String) Reason the completion finished (stop, length, etc.).
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `prompt_tokens` (Number) Number of tokens in the prompt.
- `response_created` (Number) Unix timestamp of when the response was created.
- `response_id` (String) Unique identifier for this completion.
- `response_model` (String) Actual model used for the completion.
- `response_object` (String) Object type (e.g., chat.completion).
- `total_tokens` (Number) Total number of tokens used.

<a id="nestedblock--messages"></a>
### Nested Schema for `messages`

Required:

- `content` (String) Content of the message.
- `role` (String) Role of the message. Must be one of: system, user, assistant.

Optional:

- `name` (String) Name of the sender (optional).
